lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular horizontal and vertical alignments across the central lateral flank, forming a non-uniform grid posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a discernible lattice-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-section of the flank.
